summary: doctor verifies credentials with a free /balance read; polls stop at --wait-timeout and tolerate transient errors; any post-submit failure keeps the prediction ID and the prediction-results recovery command; a failed download after a completed paid run is a warning (exit 6, partial_failure) across run/batch/pack/variants/aspects/compose/restyle; a pack rerun archives the superseded manifest as manifest.superseded-<ts>.json.
reason: WaveSpeed bills per accepted prediction. The WaveSpeed-specific doctor probe and post-submit recovery behavior stay hand-authored.
